name: code-reference
description: Replies that point at code: ask with /code-reference (or review a PR) and each place the reply names opens in a code pane beside it, the prose linked to it and boxed under each section. Drawn the same in the terminal and the desktop app. PRs are read with gh, a GitHub MCP server or git, and checked out into a review worktree.

autoReview.title: Review when you ask for one
autoReview.description: Treat a prompt that says review with a GitHub PR link, a PR link alone, or "review pr", "review pr 418", "pr review" as a review request in the code-reference format, without the slash command.

ideCommand.title: Editor command
ideCommand.description: The command the pane's editor link uses to open a file at a line, such as code, cursor, zed, idea or goland. Leave empty to find the editor you run Claude Code in.

ghPath.title: gh executable
ghPath.description: The GitHub CLI used to read pull requests. Use a full path if gh is not on the PATH Claude Code sees. Without it, a GitHub MCP server or plain git is used.

offerSetup.title: Offer to install what it can use
offerSetup.description: Once after install, ask whether to install what code-reference can use and this machine lacks: the GitHub CLI, Ghostty and terminal-browser. Nothing is installed without a yes.
